name: My Zypp Stikks 28 Pack x 1g Prerolls - Super Boof
description:
Twenty-eight joints, one jar. The My Zypp Stikks Super Boof 28-pack gives you twenty-eight full-gram pre-rolls — 28 grams total — rolled and ready to smoke, packed in a sealed jar that keeps them fresh. No grinding, no rolling, no running out.

Super Boof brings a bright, layered profile: sweet dark cherry and berry up front, brightened by zesty citrus and finished with a subtly gassy, earthy edge.

28 × 1G pre-rolls — 28 grams total, serious value in one jar
Jar packaging — keeps every joint fresh and protected
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Super Boof flavor — sweet cherry and berry with zesty citrus and gas

My Zypp Stikks Super Boof is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
